mainEntity.name: How do I know whether AI marketing automation is actually working for my business?

acceptedAnswer.text: A useful AI marketing system should improve a measurable business process, not merely generate more text. Run My AI Biz’s examples support goals such as consistent newsletter production, lead-magnet development, funnel preparation, content repurposing, research, and recurring administrative checks. Key factors include time saved, editing effort, error rate, qualified responses, subscriber actions, and revenue-related outcomes. Establish a baseline before automating and compare results after a defined test period. Stop or revise workflows that increase corrections without improving the target outcome. Run My AI Biz encourages practical experimentation instead of guaranteed growth claims.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure the process and the business result: drafting time, editing time, errors, publishing consistency, qualified responses, sign-ups, conversions, or other defined outcomes. Establish a baseline first and revise workflows that create more correction work than value. Run My AI Biz treats testing as essential.
